notes.title: Update 0.1.8.0 – Skill Tree Overhaul & More
notes.content:
[h3]Changes & Additions[/h3][list][*][p]Skill Tree redesigned and updated[/p][/*][*][p][b]38 passive skills[/b] added[/p][/*][*][p]New quests added[/p][/*][*][p]Village [b]Oak Meadow[/b] slightly expanded[/p][/*][*][p]New items added[/p][/*][*][p]Projectile collision improved[/p][/*][*][p]Performance of lighting effects improved[/p][/*][*][p]General performance slightly optimized[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p]This is a very important update because I finally managed to implement the new skill tree. It’s not finished yet, but it shows the direction I’m aiming for. There is now a skill tree for the character and for each weapon type: [b]1-Hand, Off-Hand, 2-Hand, and Bow[/b].[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44418876/ca06b629d9e89796b5dba392984e9f931e1f84b7.png"][/img][/p][p]The character skill tree mainly focuses on passive improvements like [b]range damage, melee damage, more health[/b], and more, also buffs, as well as a few active character skills. For the weapon skill trees, no new content has been added yet, but I will focus on expanding these gradually more in future updates.[/p][p]I also spent a lot of time adding new quests. It’s quite eye-opening how much time this takes. Two quests even have multiple possible outcomes, a first test run. The effort for implementing quests and writing all dialogues is significant, so I will scale back quest work for now to focus more on expanding the world, adding new points of interest, and puzzles.[/p][p]Additionally, I worked further on lighting effects, since light and shadows are the biggest performance drain. Some improvements have been made, and I switched from [b]DirectX 12 to 11[/b], disabling [b]Lumen[/b]. I hope this reduces issues for players with older systems.[/p][p]My focus now is mostly on continuing world expansion, hoping that the next area update by the end of September won’t be too small.[/p][p][/p][p]Best regards,
[b]Mark Koch[/b]
[/p][p]And never forget: [b]Have Fun![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.7.8 – Quests, Necklaces & More
notes.content:
[h3]Update 0.1.7.8[/h3][list][*][p][b]Quest Log[/b]: All quest descriptions have been added. You can now read every quest with all known details in the log.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Content[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]New quests in the world[/p][/*][*][p]New story notes[/p][/*][*][p]Necklaces as a new equipment type[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting recipes for necklaces[/p][/*][*][p]Drop chance for necklaces[/p][/*][*][p]Several new unique items[/p][/*][*][p]3 new puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]1 new dungeon + 1 small cave[/p][/*][*][p][b]New points of interest in the world[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bugfixes[/b]: Fixed several issues.[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p]This update took a bit longer than planned, sorry for the delay! The main focus was finishing all quest descriptions for the logbook, which was introduced in the last update. With necklaces now in the game, [b]all equipment types are finally covered[/b]. I’ll be testing balance over the next days, since things might have become a bit too easy, the difference between normal gear, named gear, and artifact items is pretty big.[/p][p]I haven’t had the chance to fully test everything yet. I really hope the new quests don’t contain any bugs, and I’ll be doing more thorough testing in the coming days.[/p][p]Besides the quests, I also added new [b]points of interest[/b], and the [b]world map will be updated in the next days[/b] to reflect all new content.[/p][p]I’m a little behind schedule because creating quests (texts, items, requirements, and conditions) takes more time than expected. But more quests are already in progress and will be added in future updates.[/p][p]The next focus will be [b]expanding the new areas[/b] while also working on the [b]new skill tree system[/b], which is already in progress. The new setup will include multiple trees:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]character skill tree[/b] with passive skills, buffs and some active skills[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon based skill trees for [b]1 hand weapons[/b], [b]off hand (shield/pistol)[/b], [b]2 hand weapons[/b], and [b]bows[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]The foundation is mostly done, so with a bit of luck it might make it into the next update. I also want to rework older skills since many date back to the early development days and deserve a full overhaul.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Best regards,
[b]Mark Koch[/b]
And never forget: [b]Have Fun![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.7.6c Roof Fixes, Boar Chops & Zone Progress
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the destruction model of mined rocks was not showing up.

Fixed an issue that prevented projectiles from destroying destructible objects.

A temporary collision check has been added to built houses, allowing roofs to be hidden when entering.

This avoids conflicts with other collisions that prevented roofs from disappearing.

Right now, the roof only appears after the player enters the house once.

This is a temporary workaround until a proper roof setup logic at build completion is added.

Boar death sound volume reduced by 70%.

Fixed a bug where boars and wolves played an extra, incorrect sound on death.

Added Boar Chops as loot and food item. 🥩

The new area’s flora, fauna, and environment are now complete. 🌿🌄

The world map will be adjusted in the coming days.

🛠️ Focus for the next few weeks:

The new area’s with loot filling.

NPCs, dialogues, and quests

New items & crafting recipes

Points of interest and related dungeons

📌 Goal is to check off most of this by the end of the month.

Best regards,
Mark Koch
and as always: Have Fun!

notes.title: Update 0.1.7.6b – Bug Fixes, Boars & Small Improvements
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented building houses.

Item drop physics have been adjusted – they no longer roll or slide as far.

Ranged enemies’ attack speed reduced by 30%.

Some bow skills now have a shorter cast time.

Explosive Arrow now has 50% reduced cooldown.

Shield skills now finally have visual effects.

Added a new animal for more variety in the forests: the wild boar 🐗

🔧 Known issue:
There’s currently a bug with built structures, when trees accidentally respawn inside them. This causes collision issues and prevents roofs from disappearing correctly.
As long as trees are inside the building, the system struggles to display things properly. Once the trees are cut down again, everything works fine.
I'm still looking for a fix for this.

🥩 Wild boars don’t drop their proper loot yet, and their cooking recipes will be added in a future update.

Most of my time is still focused on building the new area.

Best regards,
Mark Koch

and don’t forget: Have Fun!

notes.title: Update 0.1.7.6 – First Area Expansion & Setup for Future Content
notes.content:
This update introduces the first expansion of the game world – it's not fully finished yet, but the foundation is laid. I'm currently working on the flora and fauna, which I plan to complete in the next few days.

Once that's done, I’ll focus on quests, loot, and other content.
New armor, weapons, and matching crafting recipes will come with the new area. I expect to have items and recipes ready by next week.

The new area will also introduce the first “faction” – though I’m still unsure if that’s the right word. Guild doesn’t quite fit, and faction also sounds a bit off.
Let’s call it a thieves’ organization for now.

To avoid false expectations:
There will be no reputation system in the game.
Factions will be kept simple – mostly unlocked via quests, giving access to more quests and specific rewards later on.

It could be possible in the future to have mutually exclusive choices, but I haven’t decided on that yet. That’s a topic for later.

📌 Goal for May:
Add the first faction/organization with the new area.
In parallel, I’ll continue filling the current world with dungeons and quests, especially focusing on the second village, which still needs a lot of content.
That’s the main focus until June.

⚙️ Other tweaks & fixes in this update:

Weather: Thunderstorm chance reduced by 75%.

Bandit voice lines have been removed – they sounded terrible and will be replaced once I can record something better.

Character preview added to the inventory screen – still experimental.

Your character’s level is now displayed beneath the model in the inventory.

Several collision issues and miscellaneous bugs have been fixed.

Best regards,
Mark Koch
and as always – Have Fun! 🎮🔥

notes.title: Update 0.1.7.2 – Bug Fixes, Balancing & Learned a Bit of English
notes.content:
Update 0.1.7.2

Right now, I’m trying to create a new trailer. To gather enough video material, I played my game extensively and got my ass kicked constantly... I realized that running back all the time is pretty exhausting.

Additionally, I noticed a few bugs while playing and watching AresLps' stream (much love ❤️), which I want to fix with this update. That’s why this is a slightly bigger patch with bug fixes and balancing adjustments:

Brightness during rain and thunderstorms has been adjusted so it no longer looks like nighttime.
The guy in the tavern has learned English – his dialogue is no longer in German!
I also learned a bit of English – Wulf is now Wolf.
Some collision issues have been fixed.
Ranged weapons now deal more damage.
Some ranged skills now cost less energy.
The pistol now scales with Strength instead of partly with Dex.
Items now have a higher chance to roll Dex for ranged damage scaling.
Two-handed weapon damage has been partially reduced.
The Defence stat on items is no longer a percentage but a fixed value.
The stats of Cassandra Relic armor pieces now work properly.
The light from Cassandra’s Helm has been reworked and hopefully won’t go out anymore.
Enemy damage has been reduced.
The armor value of bandits has been drastically reduced.
Energy potions have been fixed.
Gems now only drop at Level 1 and always stack.
Lockpicks now stack up to 25.
The monster volume for dogs has been lowered.
The bear volume has been significantly reduced.
The chest in the shipwreck for the logbook has been repositioned to be more obvious.
The logbook tutorial questline had a bug where the quest kept reappearing even after completion. From now on, every quest in the questline will be removed upon leaving the first village – even if it shows up again later.
The collision of barrels and crates has been increased so projectiles hit them more easily.
I hope all these changes work as intended. I can only test it properly tomorrow – and hopefully, I won’t be eating dirt as often. At 42, running for miles over and over again is quite tiring. It might be a little too easy now, but we’ll see. Balancing and math are tricky.

Update: Fix ESC is now working on Pause Menu!

Best regards, Mark Koch
And don’t forget: Have fun! 🎮

notes.title: A somewhat larger update featuring the revisions from the last month.
notes.content:
I think the biggest change in the update is that you can now level up all skills to level 10. Unfortunately, I caused a small bug with this because the prerequisites for the previous skills no longer work. That's what a skill tree is all about: you need to learn the previous skill before you can learn a new one. Since the skill tree is still a bit jumbled and will later be divided into weapon types, I temporarily converted it into a grid structure without skill prerequisites until I fix the issue. The only prerequisite for skills now is the level, and you can just learn the last skill once you reach the required level.

In addition, there are now bandits on the map. They use the same AI, so they’re pretty dumb, but they add some variety. I didn’t create any bandit camps for the spawn points; in the demo, they are present in two locations.

I’ve also updated all the armors with a new skeleton and adjusted the loot in enemy drops accordingly. I haven’t gotten around to the chests yet, but they’ll be updated in the next few days. It’s still possible that old armors may drop in chests.

I think that covers the most important changes. Here's a rough list of the update:

- Added Private Storage Chest in Village
- Added New Items
- Added New Crafting Recipes
- Added Armor Workbench to Build Menu
- Reworked Armors
- Temporarily Reworked Skill Tree
- Added Skill Levels to Skills
- Reworked Enemy Drops and Drop Rates
- Added New Enemy: Bear
- Added New Enemy: Bandits
- Added Bandit Camps
- Improved Performance
- Various Small Adjustments and Fixes

Don't forget: Fun!

notes.title: Demo Build Update
notes.content:
With the Update to v0.008, I've finally to save its state—specifically for harvested resources like stones and trees. This means that these resources are now finite. Once they’re harvested, they won’t respawn when the world is reloaded.

With the current build, building is now possible anywhere, even in the middle of a forest. Only points of interest and dungeons are blocked from construction. I’ve been working on this resource-saving functionality for quite some time, and this current version is the first stable one, as far as I could test it.

In the demo area, there are approximately 60,000 trees and 20,000 stones available to harvest. I have no idea how well the system will handle thousands of trees being chopped down. In my tests, I only harvested about 100 trees or so, and it worked smoothly.

I also tried creating a dedicated demo build, but I abandoned the idea after a few days because it took too much time and effort. This means that, unfortunately, the demo will remain the same size as the full build, with the rest of the game world locked for demo purposes. However, I’ve managed to reduce the overall game size slightly by cleaning up some unnecessary files, saving a few gigabytes.

I apologize for the demo’s size, and I appreciate your understanding.

Wishing you all a Happy New Year—and don’t forget: Have Fun!

notes.title: Main Update for Improved Performance and Elimination of Walking Stutters!
notes.content:
With this update, I aim to improve performance and eliminate the small stutters that occurred while walking. In the future, I plan to introduce enhanced system settings that will hopefully make the game playable on older PCs as well.

Additionally, projectile weapons and their skills have been reintroduced and reworked in this update. Unfortunately, there are still some issues that might cause projectiles to miss their target—so this is still a work in progress.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44418876/2ebd54993819cd4c019625da03a4142b4e6e527c.png[/img]
Points of interest have also been added to the world map.

For feedback, you’re always welcome to join my Discord: https://discord.gg/MJYEpS56u4

And don’t forget: Have fun!
